articles.title: OpenAI Launches GPT-5 with Extended Reasoning and Native Multimodal Generation
articles.summary: OpenAI officially released GPT-5, featuring significantly improved long-horizon reasoning, native image and audio generation within a single model, and a 1M-token context window. Benchmarks show substantial gains in PhD-level science QA, competitive programming, and agentic task completion, narrowing the gap toward robust general-purpose AI assistants.

articles.title: Google DeepMind Demonstrates Gemini-Powered Robot That Learns Household Tasks from a Single Video
articles.summary: DeepMind unveiled a research prototype integrating Gemini 2.5 with a mobile manipulator robot that can watch a single human demonstration video and replicate multi-step household tasks like loading a dishwasher or folding laundry. The system uses a novel vision-language-action architecture that grounds language instructions into continuous motor plans, achieving a 78% first-attempt success rate in unseen kitchens.

articles.title: Anthropic Introduces Claude Tool-Use Orchestration for Enterprise Multi-Agent Workflows
articles.summary: Anthropic released a new enterprise platform layer that allows Claude models to dynamically spawn, delegate to, and supervise sub-agents across complex business workflows with built-in safety guardrails. The system features structured audit trails, role-based permission scoping, and human-in-the-loop breakpoints, targeting regulated industries like finance and healthcare that need verifiable AI automation.

articles.title: Tesla Optimus Gen-3 Begins Limited Deployment in Automotive Manufacturing Lines
articles.summary: Tesla confirmed that its third-generation Optimus humanoid robot has started performing real production tasks at two of its US factories, including parts sorting, bin picking, and quality inspection along the assembly line. The company reported the robots are operating 18-hour shifts with a per-unit manipulation error rate under 0.3%, marking the first sustained industrial deployment of a general-purpose humanoid.

articles.title: TSMC Announces 1.4nm Process Node on Track for 2027 with Backside Power Delivery
articles.summary: TSMC confirmed at its annual technology symposium that its A14 (1.4nm-class) process node remains on schedule for risk production in early 2027, featuring backside power delivery network technology for improved performance density. The node promises an 18% speed improvement and 22% power reduction over the current N2 node, with Apple and Nvidia reportedly among early adopters.

articles.title: Meta Releases Open-Source Llama 4 Behemoth with Mixture-of-Experts Architecture at 2T Parameters
articles.summary: Meta publicly released the full weights of Llama 4 Behemoth, a 2-trillion-parameter mixture-of-experts model that activates roughly 400B parameters per forward pass. The model matches or exceeds proprietary frontier models on major reasoning and coding benchmarks, and Meta is positioning it as the foundation for on-premise enterprise deployments and fine-tuned domain-specific applications.

articles.title: Breakthrough Solid-State Battery from QuantumScape Achieves 1,000-Cycle Durability in EV-Format Cells
articles.summary: QuantumScape published independently validated data showing its multilayer solid-state lithium-metal cells retained over 90% capacity after 1,000 full charge-discharge cycles at automotive-relevant conditions, a critical milestone for commercialization. The cells deliver roughly 50% higher energy density than conventional lithium-ion packs, potentially enabling 500+ mile EV range with faster charging times.

articles.title: Boston Dynamics and Hyundai Unveil Electric Atlas Performing Coordinated Multi-Robot Construction Tasks
articles.summary: Boston Dynamics demonstrated a team of three electric Atlas humanoid robots working in coordination to assemble steel framing components on a simulated construction site, including beam carrying, bolt insertion, and welding prep. The robots used a shared spatial map and real-time task negotiation protocol, representing a significant step toward multi-robot collaboration in unstructured environments.
